name: Sibar Auto Parts Limited
about: Sibar Auto Parts Limited engages manufacturing and sale of spare parts for automobiles in India. The company offers gravity die, low pressure die, and centrifugal casting products; and cylinder heads, crankcases for three wheelers, aluminum parts for CAC tanks, as well as connectors and core boxes. It also provides electro-plating products. In addition, the company serves OEMs/replacement market. Sibar Auto Parts Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Tirupati, India.
